member.name: P:System.Net.HttpWebRequest.IsAuthCall
member.summary: Gets or sets whether the request is marked as an authentication request for the console's network stack.
member.value: true to mark the request as an authentication call; otherwise, false. The default is false.
member.remarks: The flag is passed to the platform network stack when the request is sent.
